functions.name: apply_user_role
functions.title: Apply user role
functions.description: Set the signed-in user's app role during registration (passenger, driver, staff, or company). Only a brand-new user or an admin may change a role.

functions.name: book_taxi
functions.title: Book a taxi
functions.description: List taxi operators or book an unassigned taxi trip for the signed-in user. Use action 'list' to get operators, or action 'book' (default) with passenger and trip details to create a scheduled trip.

action.description: 'list' returns taxi operators; 'book' creates a trip. Defaults to 'book'.

company_id.description: ID of the taxi operator company (required when booking).

functions.name: ask_bus_assistant
functions.title: Ask bus assistant
functions.description: Answer a passenger's question about live buses (e.g. how far away a bus is) using real-time fleet data for a company.

company_id.description: The company to scope the fleet data to.

functions.name: admin_fleet_briefing
functions.title: Admin fleet briefing
functions.description: Generate an AI briefing of current fleet activity for admins — summary, anomaly flags, suggested actions, and a draft broadcast message.
